services.name: agentgateway-init
command: mkdir -p /config; if [ ! -f /config/config.yaml ]; then echo '' | base64 -d > /config/config.yaml; if [ -n "${GRIST_MCP_URL}" ]; then echo '' | base64 -d >> /config/config.yaml; fi; fi; chown -R 65532:65532 /config; touch /tmp/ready; while :; do sleep 3600; done
